zh.title: 立委盼高鐵新車設親子車廂 陳世凱：值得試辦
zh.summary: 陳世凱：新車上線後有空間就會試辦
body: 國民黨立委遊顥今天在立法院施政總質詢時提到，有親子乘坐高鐵時，因小孩發出聲音，家長被站務人員要求安撫小孩，後來又被要求把小孩帶離車廂，詢問交通部是否計畫設親子車廂。
交通部長陳世凱答詢表示，已與高鐵公司討論過，但高鐵車廂空間較擁擠，加上若設置親子區後孩子跑到其他車廂是否造成其他乘客不開心，這些問題還在討論中。
陳世凱表示，這是值得討論的方向，未來高鐵新車陸續上線後，空間有餘裕就會趕快試辦，是很值得試辦的方向。行政院長卓榮泰也表示，若車廂有餘裕，非尖峯時段班次的特定車廂可進行可行性評估。

en.title: Lawmaker seeks family carriages on new Taiwan HSR trains; minister calls it worth trialing
en.summary: Taiwan HSR family carriage: transport minister says trial likely when new trains have spare space
body: Kuomintang lawmaker Zhang Hao raised a question during Thursday's general interpellation session, telling of a family asked to leave an HSR carriage because their child had made noise, and asking whether the government plans dedicated family carriages.
Transport Minister Chen Shih-kai responded that he has discussed the matter with Taiwan HSR, but that carriages are crowded and there are questions over children moving to other carriages.

He said it is a direction worth trialing, and once new HSR trains come online with spare space, a trial would be conducted. Premier Cho Jung-tai said feasibility could be assessed for specific carriages on off-peak trains if there is spare space.
